title: Dragging a shape in acre-gui rewrites its source
body:
`acre-gui` redraws the render when the text changes. The render pane takes no input. Jack wants the other direction as well: dragging or stretching a shape in the render rewrites the literal in the source that placed it.

`lang::parse` keeps a `Span` on every node, property and value, and drops comments and whitespace. `scene::build` returns objects with no link back to the node that made them.

## Proposal

To be designed. A note on acre-4518a5 lists what `lang` and `scene` need: a parse that keeps comments and whitespace, the span of every value in the scene, an id on every object that carries through to its primitives, and a hit test from a canvas point to an object.

## Open

- Each span indexes the source text, so replacing the text under one value's span may be enough to rewrite a literal without a parse that keeps whitespace. Nobody has tried it.
- What a drag does to a value computed from other values.
